Vietnam’s power mix has shifted from hydropower dominance toward thermal reliance, with coal capacity under EVN/GENCOs growing to **11,384 MW by end-2018** (summing GENCO1: 4,920 MW; GENCO2: 2,240 MW; GENCO3: 2,424 MW; EVN: 1,800 MW) (EVN Annual Report 2018). Chronic challenges persist—project delays (e.g., Long Phú I pushed to 2026), financing constraints, fuel supply uncertainties, and community opposition (Report 58 Annex).
